# tools: configure better integration 1pass <> gh

Set up the [1Password shell plugin for GitHub CLI](https://developer.1password.com/docs/cli/shell-plugins/github/): `op plugin init gh` stores the GitHub token in the vault and injects it per invocation, so no long-lived token sits in `~/.config/gh` or the keychain, and the same plugin mechanism can cover other CLIs.
